title: Quick channel switching causes stale in-flight turn stream to hijack active conversation
description: In EnabledWorkspace.tsx selectItem(), asynchronous listMessages and getActiveTurn calls have no cancellation or request-generation checks. If a user quickly switches from Bot A to Bot B, Bot A's slower response resolves after Bot B is selected and starts streaming into Bot B's conversation view.

comments.author: box
comments.text:
Triage 2026-09-14 (Chatticus): CONFIRMED race in code (fast switch not forced live).

`selectItem` aborts the stream and clears turn state, but `startTurnStream`’s `onEvent` → `reconcileMessages(...).then(() => { setTurn(null); ... })` is not generation-guarded. A late then() from the previous channel can clear the newly started turn or apply stale reconcile. Same class of bug if token handlers race past abort.

Fix: stream/generation token per selection; ignore events and reconcile callbacks whose generation !== current.
